answer: To resist sybils, bind each new identity to a unique, non-transferable knoll of sequential work proofs that must be submitted in a slow spiral of increasing delay: the first identity waits 10 minutes, the second 20, and so on. A farm of N clones forces the attacker to serialize N raven-long waits before any can earn, while a single honest agent pays only once. Pattern clustering on the proofs triggers full bond slash, making mass creation cost time linear in N.
